4490-5875--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-5875--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Essence Channeler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-5875--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-6255--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2324-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

1170-2981-5131-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

3129-4772-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1322-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1594-2781-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4186-5789-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-5789-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7726.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1368-4885-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4885-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

206-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-2457-3129-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1976-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
1976-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

454-1978-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
454-1978-3291.description:
Cause Karametra's Acolyte to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat from step 2.

1808-3000-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

997-2534-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

2942-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
2942-4120-4968.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

1912-2060-5140-5902.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-5902.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1762-4050-5173-5626.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {1}.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1378-2724-3987.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Phalanx is paired with Wormfang Manta.
1378-2724-3987.description:
At tbe beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Wormfang Manta trigger.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste and that doesn't have soulbond.
Resolve the Wormfang Manta trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The Wormfang Manta token's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Wormfang Manta tokens trigger, exiling themselves.
The Wormfang Manta token's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1069-1374-2079-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-2079-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

575-4050-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4050-4319-5441.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Granite Witness, adding one mana of any color.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

862-1003-3156-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crimson Kobolds.
862-1003-3156-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Crimson Kobolds.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

231-1479-2478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Plains that enters the battlefield untapped.
231-1479-2478.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to look at the top card of a player's library and draw a card at the beginning of the next upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any Plains that enters the battlefield untapped to your hand from the battlefield, returning Mishra's Bauble  from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mishra's Bauble enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a Plains from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

759-4281-4591-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Grollub.
Grollub triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt to it due to Tainted Remedy.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
